Name: Nebushasban
Summary: Nebushasban, titled Rab-saris (chief eunuch), was one of the Babylonian officers sent to take Jeremiah out of the prison court after Jerusalem fell.
KeyStory: Nebushasban joined Nebuzaradan's party in sending for Jeremiah and bringing him out of the court of the prison.
LifeLesson: Small acts of obedience by minor officials can be the hinge of a prophet's survival.
